description: SWC Mac demo evidence inventory; not a binary-similarity configuration or score report.
reference: Super Wing Commander Mac demo 1.0.2, extracted 68000 CODE resources
address_convention: Byte offsets from the start of each CODE resource, including its segment header; end offsets are exclusive.
validation_strategy: Original instructions, original-data inspection and native compilation. Win32 changes are checked with binary-comp. The earlier automated checks recorded in status_review have been removed at user request; historical results do not establish interactive parity or SWC binary similarity.
host_selection: SWC is selected from the directory's contents: GUI validation, or without the GUI the working directory, chooses the demo when CMFs is present without WC1's GAMEDAT/MODULE.000; a directory holding both starts WC1. There is no SWC command-line switch. Shared LoadMissionData never detects SWC. The SWC host calls SdlLoadSwcMissionData directly. Runtime --check modes and GUI snapshot/auto-launch automation are removed; the asset viewer retains BMP export. SWC and its music bank remain included in SDL builds/packages, never in the original Win32 target. Forked files (the application, MIDI/*.MooV, AIFF/Stranded.aif) are read natively, from raw .rsrc or AppleDouble sidecars, or from MacBinary I/II/III copies such as discmaster's MM06.iso folder; src/sdl/swc_mission.c SdlFindSwcResources is shared by the game and GUI validation.
